title: energy.raw event (1-minute reading)
description: One UCI reading replayed as a stream. When is_missing is true the keys 'target' and 'features' are ABSENT (absent == null).

schema_version.description: Contract version. Consumers must reject unknown major versions.

run_id.description: One id per experiment run; shared by every topic and every teammate's output.

meter_id.description: Kafka message key. uci-001 is the real series; uci-002.. are load replicas.

event_id.description: Deterministic: <meter_id>-<event_time as YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ>. Same across runs; unique within (run_id).

event_time.description: UCI timestamp, labelled UTC, minute resolution. THE time axis for windowing, storage and joins.

seq.description: Per-run emission counter across all meters, starting at 0: seq = minute_index * n_meters + meter_index. Used to count loss/duplication and by the latency probe.

replay_time_ms.description: Wall-clock Unix epoch ms at which the replay producer emitted the record. Used for end-to-end latency.

is_missing.description: True if the source row had no target reading ('?').

features.description: Six input features. A key is omitted if that single value was missing in the source.
